description: `list[str]`, `dict[str, int]`, `tuple[int, ...]`: subscripting the builtin classes (PEP 585, Python 3.9) instead of `typing.List` and friends.
Returns the resolved annotations of a function, class or module: strings evaluated, `None` turned into `NoneType`, base classes merged.
`*args: T` and `**kwargs: T` annotate each element, not the tuple or dict that collects them.
The type of the receiver (PEP 673, Python 3.11), used for methods that return `self` or take another instance of the same class.
